purpose: Ablate the deterministic model used for the real-MOLA results; no stochastic-bridge retraining.
primary_evaluation: All six archived external tiles, all three seeds, seven selector instances collapsed into five equally weighted families; no early stopping or selection on external targets.
no_uncertainty: Zero only input channel 3 (posterior standard deviation) in the velocity network; compute mobility from the original uncertainty, independently.
no_gate: Keep all input channels; replace scalar mobility field with one. This is the identity-mobility analogue in this implementation, not a full matrix metric.
plain_unet: Same initialized U-Net backbone and parameter count; one direct residual prediction on GP mean with uncertainty channel zero, state zero, fixed time channel 0.5; no iterative transport or mobility gating. GP mean, other inputs, losses and postprocessing remain. This is NOT a no-GP/no-laser baseline.
no_terminal: Reuse full weights; remove soft terminal GP correction (48 pixels, 8m noise); retain final lowpass and local point-consistency operations. Compare both before and after projection.
no_projection: Reuse full weights; retain soft terminal correction; omit BOTH 320m lowpass anchoring and final local consistency correction.
observation_operator: Archived bilinear point sampling, with rounded point maps for training supervision; NOT finite-area footprint integration. R2.4 remains separate.
postprocessing: Own model K0 anchor per seed; 320m lowpass then local GP consistency, lengthscale16 pixels and noise0m as archived v36.
reporting: Absolute heldout-MOLA RMSE, aligned-reference detail RMSE, false detail fraction, lowpass RMSE, context RMSE, K0, raw and terminal and projected stages. Matched per-tile differences and tile-bootstrap intervals, not 126 independent samples.
resources: One GPU at a time initially; leave the other GPU available for the concurrent project. Do not terminate unrelated processes.
failure_policy: Stop on numerical or integrity failure. Never reduce updates, seeds or sample coverage silently. Interrupted stages have weight snapshots only, not optimizer-resumable checkpoints; retain failed attempts and restart the affected stage from its original seed only after reporting. Completed stages may be reused after hash and protocol verification.
paper_editing: Do not modify the manuscript or reply letters during execution. Report measured results even if the proposed mechanism does not improve them.
